mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of months following YoY GDP acceleration.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production, signaled by a 3% monthly decline in the INDPRO index, indicates a supply shock that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of months following a 3% INDPRO drop.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate, especially if the UNRATE increases by more than 0.5 percentage points in a quarter, signals labor market weakness that will drag on consumer spending and negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 55% of quarters following a 0.5pp UNRATE increase.

mechanism_narrative: When the housing starts (HOUST) series is rising and the RSAFS series is also expanding, it signals a broadening recovery in the housing sector that will boost related industries and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of months when both HOUST and RSAFS are rising.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and rising, it signals a tightening monetary policy that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days, especially if the CPI inflation gauge is also high.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 45% of months when FEDFUNDS > 4% and rising, and CPIAUCSL is above its 12-month average.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in payroll employment (PAYEMS), especially if it falls by more than 200,000 jobs in a month, signals a rapidly weakening labor market that will negatively impact consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of months following a 200,000+ job loss in PAYEMS.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is rising and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is falling, it signals a healthy supply-side environment that will support positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of months when INDPRO is rising and UNRATE is falling.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in real GDP (GDPC1), especially if it declines by more than 2% quarter-over-quarter, signals a rapidly slowing economy that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 55% of quarters following a 2%+ QoQ decline in GDPC1.
